meta.name: tui-design
meta.description: This skill should be used when designing terminal user interfaces, creating TUI layouts, choosing TUI color schemes, implementing keyboard navigation, building terminal dashboards, or working with any TUI framework. Activates on mentions of TUI design, terminal UI, Ratatui layout, Ink components, Textual widgets, Bubbletea views, terminal color palette, keybinding design, panel layout, split panes, terminal dashboard, box-drawing characters, sparklines, progress bars, modal dialogs, focus management, or terminal accessibility.

copy.tagline: 设计出清晰的终端界面布局与配色
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在开发终端工具时需要设计美观易用的界面
copy.tagline_en: Design clear terminal UI layouts and colors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build terminal tools needing clean, usable interfaces.

howto.what: Claude会按这套流程设计终端界面：先选择布局范式（如多面板、Miller Columns），再定义交互模型与视觉系统，最后对照反模式检查并给出方案。
howto.when: 当你说起TUI设计、终端界面、键盘导航等，或要求设计终端仪表盘、面板布局时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个终端仪表盘，包含CPU和内存监控。
用Miller Columns设计一个文件管理器布局。
给这个TUI配一套语义化颜色方案。
say.note: Claude会给出颜色槽和降级策略。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow the process to design terminal UIs: select a layout paradigm, define the interaction model and visual system, then validate against anti-patterns and deliver the design.
howto.when_en: Activates when you mention TUI design, terminal UI, keyboard navigation, or ask for terminal dashboards, panel layouts, etc.

say_en.text: Design a terminal dashboard with CPU and memory monitoring.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Widget Dashboard paradigm.

say_en.text: Create a file manager layout using Miller Columns.
say_en.note: Claude will provide a three-pane preview structure.

say_en.text: Give this TUI a semantic color scheme.
say_en.note: Claude will provide semantic slots and a degradation strategy.
